record.content: PAL architecture: TanStack Start/React frontend (src/) + FastAPI backend (backend/app/), PostgreSQL under Alembic. Layering: api/v1/<module>/router.py -> services/<module>.py -> models/. Tally integration isolated in app/integrations/tally/ (client.py httpx XML POST, xml.py builders, parser.py defensive parse, service.py facade). Company-owned routes mount under /companies/{company_id}/...; /tally and /ai are top-level. No seeded data; every company record carries companyId.
record.evidence: PAL reads company-scoped records from the FastAPI backend.
